text:
𝗔𝗨𝗦 𝟭𝟭𝟱/𝟱, 𝗡𝗘𝗘𝗗 𝟮𝟭𝟰! 😳

Australia are 115/5 after 26.1 overs chasing 329 in the Hobart decider.
England on top; Renshaw is gone.

Who wins it? 👇

#AUSvENG #Cricket

facebook.caption:
𝗔𝗨𝗦𝗧𝗥𝗔𝗟𝗜𝗔 𝟭𝟭𝟱/𝟱, 𝗠𝗨𝗦𝗛𝗞𝗜𝗟 𝗠𝗘𝗜𝗡! 😳🔥

👉 Hobart decider mein Australia 26.1 over ke baad 115/5
👉 Jeetne ke liye 23.5 over mein 214 run aur chahiye
👉 Duckett ke 133 ne England ko 328 tak pahunchaya tha

Kya Australia wapas aayegi ya England series jeetega? Comment karo 👇

#CricketKiBaat #AUSvENG #Cricket
